courses.title: Leadership Essentials

courses.title: Effective Communication

courses.title: HR Compliance Basics
courses.description: Covering workplace regulations, employee rights, and compliance best practices.

courses.title: Fullstack System Architecture & Security
courses.shortDescription: Master microservice architecture, API design, RBAC security, and dynamic workflows.
courses.description: An intensive enterprise course covering modern web architecture, distributed systems, role-based access control, security best practices, and hands-on assessments.

courses.title: Java Programming
courses.shortDescription: Core Java fundamentals and secure development practices.

courses.shortDescription: Core Java fundamentals and secure development practices.

courseSections.title: Module 1: Architecture & API Design
courseSections.description: Fundamental concepts of distributed systems and microservices.

courseSections.title: Module 2: Hands-on Assessment & Security
courseSections.description: Evaluate your knowledge with automated quizzes and a graded assignment.

learningContents.title: 1.1 Introduction to Enterprise Architecture
learningContents.description: Understanding monolithic vs microservice architectures, API gateways, and domain-driven design.

learningContents.title: 1.2 Video Walkthrough: RESTful API Principles
learningContents.description: Detailed video breakdown of HTTP verbs, status codes, payload design, and JWT auth flow.

learningContents.title: 2.1 System Architecture & Security Quiz
learningContents.description: Answer the following 3 multiple choice questions to test your comprehension.
learningContents.quizConfigJson: [{"id":1,"question":"Which HTTP status code signifies a resource was successfully created?","options":["200 OK","201 Created","400 Bad Request","500 Server Error"],"correctIndex":1,"explanation":"201 Created is the standard HTTP status code for successful creation of a resource."},{"id":2,"question":"What does JWT stand for in web security authentication?","options":["Java Web Token","JSON Web Token","JavaScript Web Transfer","Joint Work Task"],"correctIndex":1,"explanation":"JWT stands for JSON Web Token."},{"id":3,"question":"Which pattern is best suited for decoupled asynchronous event processing?","options":["Synchronous RPC","Pub/Sub Messaging Queue","Direct Database Access","Polled File Access"],"correctIndex":1,"explanation":"Publish/Subscribe messaging queues allow decoupled asynchronous message handling."}]

learningContents.title: 2.2 Practical Assignment: Build RBAC Express Service
learningContents.description: Hands-on assignment required for course completion. Submissions will be graded by the assigned Teacher.
learningContents.assignmentConfigJson: {"instructions":"Design a secure Express.js microservice API endpoint that validates JWT tokens and implements role-based access control (RBAC). Submit your solution text or GitHub repo URL below.","maxScore":100,"requiresGrading":true}
